rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Predominantly high-density dark pixel distribution (>95%) across the visible rhinarium surface, with no discernible pink or pale pixel clusters.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: A continuous, slightly concave contour edge extending from the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip in a strictly lateral view.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor notch on the posterior margin of the visible ear pinna; scattered dark punctate marks on the lateral neck and lower cheek region.
other_distinctive_markers: Open-mouth posture (yawn) exposing canines with visible apical wear and yellow-brown pigment deposition on the distal third of the crowns.
